## Buy Red Tape Formal Shoes Online At Flipkart

Shoes are the most important part of your outfit. You can’t avoid wearing shoes, so it is more of a necessity than a luxury. Research says that people are judged by the shoes they wear. So when you get yourself a pair of shoes, it is a make-or-break decision for you. Formal occasions call for formal attire. So, it is imperative that you get the right pair of shoes when you find yourself in such a situation. There are a lot of cases that are deemed as formal. Be it a job interview, your workplace or a formal dinner party; you need to dress in a way that is appropriate. Red Tape **formal shoes** are your best bet. It is made of superior quality and has a wide collection that is available online. With Red Tape formal shoes, you can look like the perfect gentleman.

**Types Of Formal Shoes**

There are different types of Red Tape formal [**shoes for men**](https://www.flipkart.com/mens-footwear/pr?sid=osp,cil) . Here’s a list of the most common and popularly worn formal shoes:  
  
**Derby Shoes** - The derby is a type of [**formal shoes**](https://www.flipkart.com/mens-footwear/formal-shoes/pr?sid=osp,cil,ssb) in which the lacing is sewn on the upper, outer side of the shoe. This way, the flaps are visible too. [**Derby shoes**](https://www.flipkart.com/q/derby-shoes) , although formal, can be worn with semi-formal outfits. It is indeed great that they can pull off a formal as well as a semi-formal look. If you’re looking for something rugged yet suave, then Derby shoes are for you.

**Lace Up Shoes** - If you’re looking for the classic formal shoes, then search no more. Lace up shoes are the good old formal [**shoes**](https://www.flipkart.com/mens-shoes-store) that everyone loves. You can never go wrong with lace up shoes if you’ve dressed formally. The shoes complement almost every formal outfit. Lace up shoes are most commonly worn with a suit and are traditionally made of leather or suede.

**Slip Ons** - Slip ons are great if you want something formal but borderline casual. Easy to wear and light in weight, they don’t have laces. As the name suggests, you just have to slip them on. They are like [**moccasins**](https://www.flipkart.com/womens-footwear/casual-shoes/moccasins/pr?sid=osp,iko,sx7,8xg) ; you can wear them with semi-formal outfits like jeans and a shirt or even with a pair of shorts.

**Pick The Right Formal Shoes For You**

If you’re planning on teaming up a pair of formal shoes with your suit or tuxedo, then here’s how to do it right:  
  
1.) Black formal shoes go well with almost any color of clothing. It could be the ideal choice. But, if you want to try brown formal shoes, then make sure your dressing goes well with your shoes.

2.) Synchronize your shoes with your belt. This way, there will be a flow to your entire outfit. If you are wearing a brown leather belt, opt for a pair of [**brown shoes**](https://www.flipkart.com/q/brown-shoes) .

3.) Get the right fit. Wearing shoes that are too tight or too loose are not just poor in taste, they can be extremely uncomfortable as well.

4.) Lace up formal shoes are perfect for a complete formal look, while slip-ons are great for a semi-formal look. If you’re wearing a complete formal outfit and the occasion calls for a reserved, formal look then opt for lace up or Derby shoes. You can wear slip ons on less formal occasions.

Choosing formal shoes can be tricky and getting a pair that suits you right is a task. However, with Red Tape formal shoes for men, you can never go wrong.

Buy Red Tape formal shoes online and choose from the vast options that are available. You’ll fall in love with the huge collection that Red Tape has to offer.
